_doc: Lobby (front-view) rig animations shared by every character (scenes/character/rig.gd, assets/README.md). Per animation: length (s), loop, tracks: bone -> {t: key times, rot: degrees added to the rest rotation (+ clockwise), x / y: part px added to the rest position (in the parent's space), sx / sy: scale}; '_flash' -> {t, v}: the muzzle flash 0..1. A character's rig.json may add or override an animation by name. Keep the motion small: the parts are drawn 1:1, and every rotation or sub-pixel move resamples them.
